# FLX-5030: the fidelity block is malformed

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

The block's shape does not match SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §2: a required section is missing, a section is not a mapping, a value has the wrong class, or a closed set (a property name, a tolerance type, a null policy, a failure action) was given a member it does not have. The block is refused before any statistic is formed.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5030
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
